segments.under: What We Look For In You
segments.text: - Familiarity with mainstream AI coding products, with strong hands-on experience or product understanding of Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Copilot, as well as context engineering, knowledge input, tool integration, human-in-the-loop collaboration, and governance considerations.
- Develop software in C/C++ with Python-based automation where appropriate
- Strong software fundamentals with solid C/C++ development experience; Python is highly desirable
- Proficiency in AI development environments (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) and expertise in AI development techniques, such as Spec-Driven Development, are required.
- Hands automation experience using any of the tools/frameworks like SoapUI/ReadyAPI, Postman, RestAssured, Selenium, Playwright, TestNG, Junit etc.
- Minimum of 3-5 years demonstrated Experience in API testing tools (ReadyAPI, Postman, RestAssured).
- Comfortable scripting languages like Python, Javascript, Ruby, Perl, Go, PHP, or Chef/Puppet etc.
- Integrating novel autonomy algorithms into UAV flight software, migrating from Python to C/C++ if necessary
- Strong proficiency with C/C++, Python, and Rust
- Rock solid Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android animations, Jetpack Navigation, and JUnit tests
- Kotlin Kotlin Coroutines · Kotlin Flow · Jetpack Navigation · Dagger 2 · Room · Custom Views, Canvas & Paint · Jetpack Compose · JUnit
- Strong proficiency in Python or Bash for automation and debugging, and the ability to read and debug service code in a compiled language such as Go.
- Familiarity with avionics data buses and communication protocols (e.g., ARINC-429, MIL-STD-1553, AFDX, CAN, SPI, UART, etc)
- Experience with programming in Python, R or Matlab is a plus.
- Deep experience with distributed computing with Apache Spark and knowledge of Spark runtime internals
